messages:
Jenna (Support): Heads-up — Helios Systems says their contract promo credit from PO #PO-7721 didn't apply to invoice INV-8891. PO note shows `Q3_INTERNAL_PROMO`, but the invoice has no promo line item. Customer is about to pay in full; they want the credit applied now. Attaching signed PO and screenshot. Can Finance do a manual grant? /cc @Sam (Sales) @Dave (Finance)

Sam (Sales): Ack. I added the PO note when we closed. I'll attach the signed PO (`Helios_PO_7721_signed.pdf`). Promo should be $6k/mo for 3 months = $18,000. Please do a manual ledger adjustment and annotate the contract so future invoices pick it up.

Dave (Finance): Can you confirm the exact promo amount and the billing account id? I need those to create the credit request.

Jenna (Support): Account id: acct_helio_01. Promo = $18,000 total. Repro steps I followed: 1) Generate invoice from contract 2) Invoice INV-8891 created 3) No "Contract Promo" line shown. Screenshot attached.

Billing Bot: Automated note: invoice INV-8891 created at 1963999000, promo flags not detected.

Alex (CS): Quick look — PO note parser expects key format `CONTRACT_PROMO:Q3` but PO has `Q3_INTERNAL_PROMO`. Mapping mismatch. We can add mapping rule or do a manual override for this account.

Dave (Finance): Ok. We'll process a manual credit for $18,000 to be applied to INV-8891. Jenna — do you want a ledger credit entry or a corrected invoice (credit note + reissue)? Need Sales approval before posting.

Sam (Sales): I approve a ledger credit. Also please add a contract annotation to prevent recurrence. :thumbsup:

Jenna (Support): Confirming ledger credit. Also can Engineering/CS accept both note variants (`CONTRACT_PROMO:...` and `*_INTERNAL_PROMO`) in the parser? This caused the miss.

Alex (CS): I'll open a quick PR to accept `_INTERNAL_` variants and add a fallback. ETA: EOD tomorrow. For immediate relief I can add a temporary mapping rule and re-run invoice generation for acct_helio_01 if Finance wants that.

Dave (Finance): Created manual credit request REF-FQ-20260317-27 for $18,000 and queued for approval. ETA 2 business days for posting once approved. I'll follow up here when posted.

Billing Bot: Credit REF-FQ-20260317-27 created by Dave (Finance). Status: pending_approval.

Jenna (Support): Thanks — Sam, can you message the customer to let them know we're applying the credit and ETA?

Sam (Sales): Done. Messaged Helios: "We're applying the credit now; adjustment will appear within 2 business days."

Alex (CS): Note for follow-up: I'll include a unit test for PO note variants and schedule a small deploy after review.

Dave (Finance): Will update thread when REF-FQ-20260317-27 posts.

Jenna (Support): Appreciate it. I'll keep the customer updated.
